item.title: United Way of Door County, AARP Foundation team up for tax-aide services
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- With less than two months to go before taxes are due to the IRS, two organizations are hoping to make the process easier and less expensive.

item.title: Conflict, seasonal change blamed for jump in gas prices
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- If you have not already filled your gas tank, it may be time to take a detour before prices rise even more.

item.title: Sturgeon Bay readies for St. Patrick’s Day festivities
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- For at least one Saturday this month, you and hundreds of other local revelers will be Irish as Destination Sturgeon Bay celebrates St. Patrick's Day on March 14.

item.title: Heart & Sole Program Helps Middle School Girls Build Confidence and Strength
item.description: Adam Collins -- As girls grow up, many face increasing social pressures and mental health challenges. Programs supported by the Wisconsin Office of Children's Mental Health (OCMH) aim to counter those trends by building confidence and resilience early.

item.title: High School Job Fair Connects Students with Local Employers Ahead of Hiring Season
item.description: Adam Collins -- Local high school students had the opportunity to explore career paths and employment options during a Job Fair held Wednesday morning at Stone Harbor Resort.

item.title: Kitchens, state legislators look to double down on cell phone ban
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Wisconsin legislators are hopeful their efforts will help your kids keep their hands off their cellphones for a little longer while at school.

item.title: Door County Employers Ramp up Hiring: What Makes a Candidate Stand Out?
item.description: Adam Collins -- Employers across Door County are ramping up hiring in preparation for the peninsula's busy tourism and business season. At Northeast Wisconsin Technical College, instructors work closely with local employers to ensure students gain the skills companies actively seek.

item.title: League of Women Voters finalizes second forum for Door County Board seats
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- As promised earlier this week, you can learn more about the four candidates running for Door County Board seats representing portions of Sturgeon Bay later this month.

item.title: Expanding Help for Neighbors in Need
item.description: Adam Collins -- The Door County Community Foundation is strengthening its efforts to support residents facing unexpected hardships through a new initiative known as the Neighbor Relief Fund.

item.title: Connecting with agriculture partners
item.description: By Matt Joski, Kewaunee County Sheriff -- Over the past few weeks, I have had some great opportunities to engage with our agriculture industry partners, both locally and statewide.
